Package net.opengis.gml._3

Class Members

java.lang.Object
net.opengis.gml._3.Members
public class Members extends Object

Java class for ArrayAssociationType complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="ArrayAssociationType">
   <complexContent>
     <restriction base="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}anyType">
       <sequence>
         <element ref="{http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2}AbstractObject" maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="0"/>
       </sequence>
       <attGroup ref="{http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2}OwnershipAttributeGroup"/>
     </restriction>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>

    • getAbstractObjects

      public List<jakarta.xml.bind.JAXBElement<?>> getAbstractObjects()
      Gets the value of the abstractObjects property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the abstractObjects property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getAbstractObjects().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list AbstractCRS AbstractContinuousCoverage AbstractCoordinateOperation AbstractCoordinateSystem AbstractCoverage AbstractCurve
